name: Pennsylvania
about: WaterWiseKids Find a Pool: a starting list of family swimming pools in all 50 states and Washington, DC. Each record was checked on the operator's own website on the date shown. Unknown means the operator does not state it - not "no". Hours and fees change: follow hours_fees_url. Report a correction: waterwisekids.com@gmail.com or https://www.waterwisekids.com/contact/

fields.components: one entry per physical pool at the venue: s = indoor|outdoor|unknown (pool not specified), e = entry eligibility (open|conditional|unknown|restricted; null = component only carries offerings), season, o = {offering: public|members|unknown}. Filters match a single component, never a combination of different pools or access arrangements.

public_access.open: public admission or non-member day pass, no material limit stated
public_access.unknown: a pass or membership exists but no official source says non-members may use the pool - not verified public access
public_access.conditional: public admission or non-member day pass with a stated limit (dates, hours, tickets, eligibility) - see access_details / conditions
public_access.restricted: members, residents or guests of members only

fields.conditions: records added in WWK-POOLS-NATIONWIDE-025: limits a parent must know (dates, residency, tickets, escort, age, ID, swim test, capacity, closures, hours) with applies_to venue|indoor|outdoor; offering-specific ones are in offering_details
fields.postal_code: null when the operator page does not print the ZIP with the street
